description: Four half days (4 x 3 h 30) and two one-hour follow-up meetings for the accessibility lead of an organisation and a deputy. Participants map services and owners, read audit findings, build a remediation plan with priorities and proof of closure, and prepare a roadmap to follow up suppliers.
length: 4 half-days (14 hours) and 2 one-hour follow-up meetings
title: Référent : piloter l'accessibilité numérique (Leading digital accessibility)
topics: Accessibility governance, audit findings, remediation planning and supplier follow-up
